herdr.how: HERDR_PANE_ID, resolved with herdr pane get

rex.how: REX_SESSION and REX_BLOCK select the block, then rex session inspect must list that block; if inspect fails the answer is refuse
rex.fix: install Rex and put its rex command on PATH: the app ships it inside the bundle at Contents/Helpers/Rex Server.rex/Contents/MacOS/rex, so link that file into a PATH directory and check it with rex version; run rex skill setup once so Claude gets Rex's skill and start hook (it does not put rex on PATH)

ghostty.how: the SessionStart hook walks the process chain to the claude process and records its tty; osascript lists Ghostty's terminals and the tty must match one (id of terminal becomes the pane id, the tty becomes the terminal id); GHOSTTY_* variables are never read; no match, an empty or ?? tty, or a tty Ghostty does not own is a refuse
ghostty.fix: run Claude inside a Ghostty window or tab, and allow Automation: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Automation, switch on Ghostty under the app that runs Claude (macOS asks once, and remembers a denial); a session in tmux, screen, ssh or another terminal app cannot be found
